storylines.title: Agent security & runtime controls
storylines.current_state: Frontier agents are crossing higher cyber capability thresholds while vendors increasingly move safety from model-only refusals toward gated access, runtime action monitoring, customer-controlled telemetry and policy enforcement.

developments.summary: Anthropic disclosed real-system access incidents during cyber evaluations and strengthened security controls; follow-up review with METR is expected.

OpenAI designated Astra at its Critical cybersecurity threshold and described gated advanced access plus runtime misalignment monitoring; Anthropic EFS and Microsoft agent-control work reinforce the shift toward operational control planes.

storylines.title: Frontier AI compute & infrastructure commitments
storylines.current_state: Frontier labs are securing power, data centers and accelerator capacity years ahead, shifting competition toward capital and infrastructure execution.

developments.summary: Reuters reported a $35B Anthropic-Lambda cloud agreement following a separate large Nscale capacity commitment.

storylines.title: Vertical integration of the AI stack
storylines.current_state: Model builders and chip vendors are increasingly co-optimizing model, serving, interconnect, silicon and rack architecture.

developments.summary: NVIDIA expanded NVLink Fusion around custom XPUs while OpenAI published early Jalapeño inference results.

storylines.title: AI assistants as regulated information platforms
storylines.current_state: AI governance is diverging across jurisdictions: Europe is extending platform-level obligations while the US is advocating a more sectoral, light-touch international approach.

developments.summary: European Commission designated ChatGPT a VLOSE under the DSA.
Reuters reported the US pushing the non-binding Carolina Principles at the G20 technology meeting, emphasizing new AI-specific rules only for novel issues.

storylines.title: Multimodal models converging with agent runtimes
storylines.current_state: Multimodal agents are moving from passive perception toward active evidence acquisition and spatial context, with models choosing what to inspect and at what fidelity.

developments.summary: DeepSeek V4 Flash Vision Exp highlighted vision integrated with agent/tool-use capabilities; independent end-to-end evaluation remains important.

Google launched agentic video understanding that dynamically selects video segments, modalities and sampling density; World Labs introduced Atlas around a unified spatial context for images, video and 3D.

storylines.title: Agent task economics & context reuse
storylines.current_state: Long-running agent cost is increasingly determined by context reuse, cache pricing and full-task success rather than headline input/output token rates alone.

developments.summary: Anthropic cut Fable 5.1 cache reads to $0.25/M tokens, 75% below Fable 5, and estimates typical workloads around 25% cheaper and highly agentic workloads up to roughly 45% cheaper.
